recovery_definition: Open state Recovery (%) = 100 * fitted open population / 0.4; not clipped
selection_definition: min-max normalised training MSE + min-max normalised HDXer work; lower gamma breaks ties
interpretation: descriptive calibration; split variation is not independent for staged arms
hdxer_work: Final-stage reported work.dat value at the saved selected training gamma; kJ/mol

work_decomposition.definition: Figure-3 LogPf PMF comparison of final-stage test versus prior
work_decomposition.delta_H_opt: mean absolute residue-wise change in H_opt
work_decomposition.delta_H_abs: RT times absolute change in ensemble-average LogPf
work_decomposition.kl_definition: KL divergence of fitted frame weights from uniform prior
